description: List rental applicants with contact details, status and their applications. Filter by application status, unit, name, email, submission date or entity. Buildium: GET /v1/applicants.

entity_id.description: Property or rental owner id (per entity_type).

entity_type.description: Scope by entity type; required with entity_id.

last_updated_from.description: Updated on or after — UTC, formatted YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

last_updated_to.description: Updated on or before — UTC, formatted YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

orderby.description: Sort, e.g. "Name", "LeaseToDate desc" or "Rent desc,City asc". Any field of the returned object.

submitted_from.description: Application submitted on or after — UTC, formatted YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

submitted_to.description: Application submitted on or before — UTC, formatted YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

name: buildium_list_applicants
title: List applicants
